name: kloudy-mcp
stderr:
Kloudy MCP

Usage:
  kloudy-mcp serve
  kloudy-mcp serve-request
  kloudy-mcp serve-http
  kloudy-mcp login
  kloudy-mcp logout
  kloudy-mcp --version

Optional environment:
  KLOUDY_API_X_BASE_URL  Override the default https://shape.kloudy.cn/api-x address
  KLOUDY_WEB_BASE_URL    Override the default https://shape.kloudy.cn address
  KLOUDY_MCP_OAUTH_RESOURCE_URL  OAuth Resource for local client login and token refresh
  KLOUDY_MCP_HTTP_HOST   serve-http listen host (default 127.0.0.1)
  KLOUDY_MCP_HTTP_PORT   serve-http listen port (default 12176)
  KLOUDY_MCP_PUBLIC_URL  OAuth resource URL (production: https://shape.kloudy.cn/mcp)
  KLOUDY_MCP_AUTHORIZATION_SERVER_URL  OAuth authorization server issuer
  KLOUDY_MCP_AUTH_CONTEXT_URL          Trusted internal token context endpoint
  KLOUDY_MCP_AUTH_CONTEXT_SERVICE_TOKEN  Service token for that endpoint

serve-request is for a trusted Agent parent process. It requires request-scoped identity
environment variables and never reads or writes the local state file.
serve-http starts the remote Streamable HTTP resource server and requires OAuth/resource
configuration. It never reads or writes the local state file.

Login opens a browser and requires an Agent Character. It is required for business API calls.
